item.title: Billie Eilish Doubles Down on ‘Eating Meat Is Inherently Wrong’ Stance by Sharing Footage of Animals Suffering
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to Trending on Billboard. Today, we're talking about Billie Eilish and her strong stance on animal rights and veganism.
Billie Eilish recently sparked controversy when she said that you can't both eat meat and claim to love animals. She shared disturbing footage of the mistreatment of livestock in the food industry, writing "stay f–king mad at ME … i really don’t give a goddamn f–k." She encouraged her followers to watch documentaries and footage of the treatment of animals and the impact on the planet.
Eilish stated that she's "so tired" of having empathy for living beings being seen as controversial, and that people should take a look at themselves if they found the footage hard to watch. This isn't the first time Eilish has spoken out on this issue. In a recent interview with Elle, she said "Eating meat is inherently wrong. Two things cannot coincide: ‘I love animals … and I eat meat.’”
Eilish is a long-time advocate for veganism, animal rights, and environmentalism, and is active in her mom's organization Support + Feed, which works to increase access to plant-based food. She's also prioritized cruelty-free manufacturing processes in her fashion partnerships, including getting Oscar de la Renta to stop using fur.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in to Trending on Billboard. Join us next time for more updates on the music world.
